execution_part.Description: The instruction truncates a vector of floating-point numbers to a vector of unsigned 32-bit integers. The result is pushed onto the stack.
The instruction attempts to truncate a vector of floating-point numbers that cannot be represented as unsigned 32-bit integers. This leads to a trap.
